description: Keeps the pinned @testingbot/cli release current. The three test Steps
invoke `npx @testingbot/cli@<cli_version>`, and the pin is what makes a
published Step reproducible -- so it has to be bumped deliberately rather
than floated to `latest`. Dependabot cannot see it: it is a bare version
string inside step.yml, not a package manifest.
Requires the Renovate GitHub App to be installed on the testingbot org.
Without it this file is inert.
